deliverables.name: The comparison letter (.html), built from the fixed template
deliverables.file: out/<First>_<Surname>_Life_Insurance_Comparison - DD.MM.YY.html (sent to Paul in the chat and saved in the client's Comparative Quotes)
deliverables.produced_by: scripts/run.py check + build (scripts/licbuild.py fills assets/Life_Comparison_TEMPLATE.html from the answers)
deliverables.handover: the file in the chat; saved through the three routes in order, never overwriting without Paul's yes

deliverables.name: The Outlook draft with the covering email (never sent by Claude)
deliverables.file: made with outlook_create_draft from out/draft_body.html; read-back saved as out/draft_readback.txt
deliverables.produced_by: scripts/run.py build (the body) and the chat (the draft)
deliverables.handover: left in Drafts; Paul attaches the saved HTML letter by hand (settings.json attach_by) and sends; the Exchange rule adds his signature once

deliverables.name: The Teams message to Sitamah
deliverables.file: printed by scripts/run.py message; read-back saved as out/message_readback.txt
deliverables.handover: sent through Zapier to the 1:1 chat after Paul's yes and a checked draft

deliverables.name: Short audit
deliverables.file: printed by scripts/verify.py; full record in out_record/audit-full.txt
deliverables.handover: pasted into the reply as it is: one line per check with a green tick or a red cross, one closing line for what is only attested
